sentences.english: You have been beaten. Give in!

sentences.japanese: 君が負けるとは夢にも思わなかった。
sentences.english: Never did I dream that you would lose.

sentences.japanese: 君が間抜けだったおかげで、僕たちはその試合に負けたんだ。
sentences.english: Thanks to your stupidity, we lost the game.

sentences.japanese: 驚いたことに彼はその試合で負けてしまった。
sentences.english: To our surprise, he was defeated in the match.
